question: How did Apple's Services net sales change in fiscal 2025, and what drove the change?

sentences.text: Apple's Services net sales were $109,158 million in 2025, up 14% from $96,169 million in 2024.
The increase was primarily due to higher net sales from advertising, the App Store and cloud services.
Higher Services net sales were also among the main reasons net sales rose in the Americas, Europe, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific.

question: How much did NVIDIA increase its supply and capacity commitments in its latest quarter, and why?

sentences.text: NVIDIA increased its supply and capacity commitments from $119 billion last quarter to $279 billion as of July 26, 2026, to meet future demand.
NVIDIA says it has entered into significant commitments to secure inventory and capacity to meet demand for the next several years, and that it is currently experiencing certain supply constraints.
NVIDIA also cautions that its demand estimates can be inaccurate and that customers may postpone buying new architectures for lack of data center infrastructure or of capital.

question: How many paid members did Costco have at the end of fiscal 2025, and what was its membership renewal rate?

sentences.text: At the end of 2025, Costco had 81,000 thousand total paid members, up from 76,200 thousand at the end of 2024.
Costco's member renewal rate at the end of 2025 was 92.3% in the U.S. and Canada and 89.8% worldwide.

Costco says its worldwide renewal rate is adversely affected by membership growth in newer international markets and by a higher share of memberships sold online, including through digital promotions, which renew at a slightly lower rate on average.
